raw_data.evidence_description: The source reports Leptocheck-WB estimates of 95.0% sensitivity (95% credible interval 79.3–100) and 76.4% specificity (95% credible interval 60.8–93.2) against the modeled combined positivity definition of leptospirosis. The study also states that MAT with an acute-serum titre of ≥400 was considered the reference standard. Leptospira biflexa serovar Patoc strain Patoc-1 was used as antigen in Leptocheck-WB, MAT, and IgM ELISA. No explicit source-reported TP, FP, FN, and TN 2×2 table for Leptocheck-WB versus MAT was located; the joint test-pattern table should not be converted into inferred four-cell counts at this extraction stage.
